book: English Grammar in Use · Raymond Murphy · Cambridge

units.title: Had better / It's time
units.grammar: Had better — настоятельная рекомендация (иначе будет плохо). It's time + past simple — давно пора. You'd better hurry. It's time we left.

exercises.q: You ___ better hurry — the train leaves in 5 minutes.

units.title: Third Conditional
units.grammar: Нереальные условия в прошлом. If + Past Perfect, would have + V3. Сожаление о несделанном.

exercises.q: If I ___ studied harder, I would have passed.
She would have come if you ___ her.
If we had left earlier, we ___ missed the train.
They ___ have won if they had played better.

units.title: Wish / Hope
units.grammar: Wish + past — сожаление о настоящем. Wish + past perfect — сожаление о прошлом. Hope — реальная надежда.

exercises.q: I wish I ___ studied more for the exam.

units.title: It is said that / He is supposed to
units.grammar: Конструкция для передачи общих утверждений: It is said that he is rich = He is said to be rich.

exercises.q: It ___ that she left the country.
She is supposed ___ a great singer.

units.title: Have something done
units.grammar: Конструкция: have + object + V3. I had my hair cut. She had her car repaired.

exercises.q: She had her car ___ last week.
We need to have the house ___ .

units.title: Reported Speech 2 (вопросы и приказы)
units.grammar: Косвенные вопросы: He asked where I lived (без do). Приказы: She told me to wait.

exercises.q: He told me ___ not touch it.

units.title: Complex Object (want you to, expect him to)
units.grammar: Конструкция: глагол + object + to + V. I want you to help me. She expects him to call.

units.title: Remember doing vs remember to do
units.grammar: Remember doing — помню, что сделал (воспоминание). Remember to do — не забыть сделать.

exercises.q: I remember ___ the door — I locked it.
Remember ___ the door when you leave!
I'll never forget ___ him for the first time.

units.title: Try / Need / Help
units.grammar: Try doing — попробовать как эксперимент. Try to do — приложить усилие. Need — особенности. Help + (to) V.

exercises.q: If you can't sleep, try ___ some warm milk.
I tried ___ the door, but it was locked.
Could you help me ___ this box?

units.title: Would rather / Prefer
units.grammar: Would rather + V (без to). Prefer + -ing / to + V. Разница между предпочтениями.

exercises.q: I would rather ___ at home tonight.

units.title: Be / Get used to
units.grammar: Be used to — привык (состояние). Get used to — привыкаю (процесс). Всегда + -ing.

exercises.q: I can't get used to ___ in this city.

units.title: Глагол + предлог + -ing
units.grammar: Некоторые глаголы требуют предлог: think of, dream of, succeed in, apologise for, insist on.

exercises.q: I'm thinking of ___ a new job.

units.title: It's no use, there's no point in
units.grammar: Выражения с -ing: It's no use / There's no point in / It's worth / It's not worth.

exercises.q: It's not worth ___ so much money on it.

units.title: -ing clauses
units.grammar: Причастные обороты с -ing: Feeling tired, I went to bed. Having finished work, she left.

exercises.q: ___ finished my work, I went home.
___ that he was late, she got angry.
___ the news, he called his mum.

units.title: The (school / the school)
units.grammar: Без the — деятельность/учреждение (go to school, in hospital). С the — конкретное место/здание.

exercises.q: I went to ___ school to pick him up.

units.title: The + прилагательное
units.grammar: The + прилагательное = группа людей: the rich, the poor, the young, the old, the French.

exercises.q: ___ French are famous for their cuisine.

units.title: Имена собственные и the (география)
units.grammar: Города без the: London. Реки, моря, океаны с the: the Thames, the Black Sea.

units.title: Имена собственные и the (улицы, отели)
units.grammar: Улицы и площади без the: Oxford Street, Red Square. Отели, театры, музеи с the: the Ritz, the Bolshoi.

units.title: Составные существительные
units.grammar: Boy friend = boyfriend. Tooth brush = toothbrush. Или с дефисом: mother-in-law.

units.title: My / Of mine / My own
units.grammar: My friend = a friend of mine. My own = мой собственный. He's a friend of mine. I have my own room.

units.title: All / Every / Whole
units.grammar: All — все (множественное). Every — каждый (ед.). Whole — целый. All day / Every day / The whole day.

units.title: Each и Every
units.grammar: Each — каждый по отдельности (2+). Every — все вместе (3+). Each student has a book. Every student has a book.

exercises.q: ___ student in the class got a book.

units.title: Relative Clauses без союзов
units.grammar: Если that/who/which — дополнение, можно опустить. The book (that) I bought. The man (who) I met.

exercises.q: The book ___ I read was great. (можно опустить)
The man ___ I met was kind.
The film ___ we watched was boring.
Is это правильный вариант? The book I bought...

units.title: Whose / Whom / Where
units.grammar: Whose — чей. Whom — кого (формально). Where — где. The man whose car was stolen...

exercises.q: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.
This is the house ___ I was born.
The woman ___ I saw was tall.
This is the place ___ we met.

units.title: Non-defining Relative Clauses
units.grammar: Уточнение с запятыми. My brother, who lives in Paris, is a doctor. Нельзя that.

exercises.q: My brother, ___ lives in Paris, is a doctor.
Paris, ___ is the capital of France, is beautiful.
The sun, ___ rises in the east, is a star.

units.title: -ing и -ed clauses
units.grammar: Причастные обороты. The man standing there is my dad. The window broken yesterday was fixed.

exercises.q: The man ___ there is my father.
The girl ___ the piano is my sister.

units.title: Порядок прилагательных
units.grammar: Порядок: opinion → size → age → shape → color → origin → material → purpose. A beautiful small old round brown Italian wooden table.

units.title: Quite / Pretty / Rather / Fairly
units.grammar: Quite — довольно (нареч. модификатор). Pretty — разговорное. Rather — скорее. Fairly — довольно (слабый).

units.title: Сравнительная степень 3 (the...the)
units.grammar: The + сравн. + the + сравн. = чем... тем. The more you study, the better you understand.

exercises.q: ___ you study, the better you'll do.
The ___ you wait, the worse it gets.
The more money he earns, ___ he wants.

units.title: Even (+ even if)
units.grammar: Even — даже. Even if — даже если. Even though — даже хотя. Даже усиливает.

exercises.q: ___ he was tired, he kept working.

units.title: In case
units.grammar: In case — на случай если. Take an umbrella in case it rains. (НЕ will!).

exercises.q: I'll take some cash ___ they don't accept cards.

units.title: Unless / As long as
units.grammar: Unless = if not. As long as = при условии что. Unless you hurry, you'll be late.

exercises.q: You can go ___ you finish your homework.

units.title: Like vs As
units.grammar: Like + сущ. (похож на). As + предложение/роль. She looks like her mum. She works as a doctor.

units.title: As if / As though
units.grammar: As if / as though = как будто. He looks as if he's seen a ghost.

exercises.q: He looks ___ he's seen a ghost.
It looks ___ it's going to rain.
He acts ___ he owns the place.

units.title: For / During / While
units.grammar: For + период (for 2 hours). During + сущ. (during the film). While + предложение (while I was sleeping).

units.title: By / Until / By the time
units.grammar: By — к моменту (by 5pm). Until — до (until 5pm, продолжалось). By the time — к тому времени как.

units.title: At the end vs In the end
units.grammar: At the end (of) — в конце чего-то. In the end — в итоге, в конечном счёте.

exercises.q: We tried hard, but ___ we failed.

units.title: To / At / In / Into
units.grammar: To — направление. At/In — местоположение. Into — внутрь. Go to school. Arrive at the station. Walk into the room.

units.title: In / At / On (устойчивые сочетания)
units.grammar: At night, in the morning, on Friday, at Christmas, on my birthday, in 2020. Запомнить устойчивые.

units.title: By
units.grammar: By = не позднее чем (by 5pm). By + транспорт (by car, by train). By + способ (by email).

units.title: Существительное + предлог
units.grammar: Устойчивые сочетания: reason for, solution to, advantage of, interest in, increase in, demand for.

exercises.q: The solution ___ the problem is simple.
She has a strong interest ___ art.

units.title: Прилагательное + предлог 1
units.grammar: Устойчивые: good at, interested in, afraid of, angry with, worried about, tired of.

units.title: Прилагательное + предлог 2
units.grammar: Продолжение: proud of, famous for, responsible for, similar to, different from, married to.

exercises.q: Paris is famous ___ the Eiffel Tower.

units.title: Глагол + предлог 2
units.grammar: Продолжение: apologise for, accuse of, insist on, rely on, congratulate on, suffer from.

units.title: Глагол + предлог 3
units.grammar: Продолжение: think of, dream of, believe in, succeed in, result in, deal with, agree with.

units.title: Глагол + предлог 4
units.grammar: Продолжение: remind of, warn about, complain about, hear from/about, ask about, care about.

exercises.q: I haven't heard ___ him for ages.

units.title: Глагол + предлог 5
units.grammar: Продолжение: prepare for, wait on, count on, refer to, point at/to, look forward to (-ing).

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Out (продолжение)
units.grammar: Work out, sort out, carry out, point out, run out of, turn out.

exercises.q: I need to ___ out this problem.
It ___ out that she was right.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: On и Off 2
units.grammar: Go on (продолжать), carry on (продолжать), put off (отложить), call off (отменить), show off (хвастаться).

exercises.q: They put ___ the meeting until Friday.
He likes to show ___ his new car.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Up и Down
units.grammar: Up — завершение/увеличение. Down — уменьшение/запись. Give up. Grow up. Look up. Turn up/down.

exercises.q: I need to ___ up this word in the dictionary.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Up (продолжение)
units.grammar: Set up (основать), take up (заняться), make up (придумать/помириться), end up (закончить), break up (расстаться).

exercises.q: I want to ___ up a new hobby.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Away и Back
units.grammar: Away — прочь/продолжая. Back — назад. Go away. Give away. Come back. Pay back.

exercises.q: Please go ___ — I need to work.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Take
units.grammar: Take after (быть похожим на), take off (снять/взлететь), take on (нанять), take up (заняться).

exercises.q: They ___ on new staff every month.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Look
units.grammar: Look after (заботиться), look for (искать), look forward to (с нетерпением ждать), look up (искать инфу), look into (разбираться).

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Get
units.grammar: Get up (вставать), get on/off (садиться/выходить), get along with (ладить), get over (преодолеть), get by (справляться).

exercises.q: Do you ___ along with your colleagues?
We can ___ by on this salary.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Put
units.grammar: Put on (надеть), put off (отложить), put up with (терпеть), put out (погасить), put away (убрать).

exercises.q: Don't ___ off till tomorrow what you can do today.
I can't ___ up with this noise.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: Come
units.grammar: Come across (наткнуться), come up with (придумать), come round (зайти), come true (сбыться), come down with (заболеть).

exercises.q: I came ___ an old photo yesterday.
She came ___ with a great idea.
